authenticity_review: The image exhibits high photorealism with accurate lighting, shadows, and material rendering (wood grain, plastic sheen, frosting texture). However, minor structural artifacts exist: the inner rim of the donut hole shows slight melting/fusion where sprinkles sink unnaturally into the frosting, and some toy wheels appear fused with their bodies rather than having distinct axles. These are subtle generation flaws but do not constitute catastrophic failure. The perceptual quality auditor reported no graphics-level distortions (noise, blur, compression), supporting a high authenticity score despite minor structural imperfections.
